entry.title: Bitcoin Resilience Presentations — August 5
entry.summary: The upcoming presentation titled "Securing Your Bitcoin with Entropy, Seeds, Shards, Airgaps, and More" is scheduled for August 5th at 10am PT. It will address various techniques to enhance the security of Bitcoin funds. This discussion is particularly timely considering the recent incident involving a Coldcard seed-creation failure, which has highlighted vulnerabilities in the management of self-sovereign controlled funds. The presenter aims to explore methods to mitigate such risks by emphasizing the importance of maintaining accurate metadata that tracks the origins of seeds and keys. Interested participants can join the session through [this Zoom link](https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88143195571?pwd=rgVeDCgOKT3IMtBiISego4p5wK0s6F.1).
